product_family: ChatGPT - AI conversational assistant available in multiple tiers: Free/Plus/Pro (consumer), Team/Business (team/organizational), Enterprise (large-scale), Edu (education), Healthcare (HIPAA-compliant), and API Platform (developer). All powered by latest GPT models with options for extended capabilities like voice, file upload, image generation, and code execution.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI's most recent SOC2 Report covers the period of January 1, 2025 to June 30, 2025 and covers controls relevant to Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and Privacy Trust Services Criteria for the API Platform, ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and ChatGPT Team.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for OpenAI's API, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Edu services, with control implementation also conforming to ISO/IEC 27017:2015, ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and ISO/IEC 27701:2019.

certifications.name: ISO 42001:2023 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI maintains an ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI Management System covering OpenAI's consumer and business AI products and models.

certifications.name: PCI-DSS
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI maintains PCI-DSS compliance for the components of ChatGPT that support delegated payment processing.

certifications.name: FedRAMP Moderate
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI has achieved FedRAMP 20x Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and API Platform.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI supports customers' compliance with privacy laws, including the GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and FERPA, and offers a Data Processing Addendum and Business Associate Agreement for customers.

certifications.name: HIPAA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI is able to sign Business Associate Agreements (BAA) in support of customers' compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). ChatGPT for Healthcare is a secure workspace designed to support HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: OpenAI contractually restricts itself from retaining, using, disclosing, or otherwise processing customer data except as necessary for business purposes specified in the agreement, when the data is subject to the CCPA. OpenAI does not 'sell' or 'share' personal data as those terms are defined by the CCPA.

privacy.ai_training_note: Training policy varies by tier. For Consumer plans (Free, Plus, Pro): Data is used for model improvement by default, but users can opt out via Settings > Data Controls > 'Do not train on my content'. For Business/Team/Enterprise/Edu plans: By default, OpenAI does not use inputs or outputs for training or improving models. ChatGPT for Healthcare explicitly does not train on data.
privacy.data_region: Available in 10+ regions: Europe, United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Australia, United Arab Emirates. Data residency can be selected for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and API Platform customers.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher between customer and OpenAI, and between OpenAI and service providers

security.name: Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
security.value: Customers can bring their own encryption keys for customer content stored at-rest, providing customer-managed encryption

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: Available in Europe, UK, US, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Australia, UAE. Covers conversations, uploaded files, custom GPTs, and image generation artifacts.

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Strict access controls to limit who can access customer data

security.name: Audit Logs
security.value: Available for enterprise customers to monitor and track access to workspace data

security.name: Custom Data Retention
security.value: Enterprise customers can configure custom data retention policies

security.name: SOC 2 Type 2 Audit Scope
security.value: Covers Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and Privacy Trust Services Criteria for API Platform, ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and ChatGPT Team

products.notes: Entry-level access to ChatGPT with limitations on model access and usage

products.name: ChatGPT Plus
products.data_scope: Personal conversations used for model training by default (opt-out available)
products.notes: Monthly subscription ($20/mo) with access to advanced models and features

products.name: ChatGPT Pro
products.data_scope: Personal conversations used for model training by default (opt-out available)
products.notes: Premium monthly subscription ($200/mo) with highest usage limits and priority access

products.name: ChatGPT Team
products.data_scope: Team data NOT used for training by default. No training on workspace data.
products.notes: Shared workspace for small teams ($30/person/month) with centralized billing and admin controls

products.name: ChatGPT Business
products.data_scope: Business data NOT used for training by default. No training on workspace data.
products.notes: Organizational workspace with extended session length, custom controls, and admin management. Governed by OpenAI Business Terms.

products.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
products.data_scope: Enterprise data NOT used for training by default. No training on workspace data.
products.notes: Enterprise-grade security with advanced data privacy controls, custom data retention, encryption at rest and in transit, data residency options, audit logs, and unlimited usage

products.name: ChatGPT Edu
products.data_scope: Educational data NOT used for training. No training on workspace data.
products.notes: Designed for educational institutions with data residency support and compliance features. Requires institutional sign-up.

products.name: ChatGPT for Healthcare
products.data_scope: Healthcare data NOT used for training. HIPAA-compliant secure workspace.
products.notes: Specialized version for healthcare organizations with Business Associate Agreement support, HIPAA compliance, data residency, audit logs, and customer-managed encryption keys

products.name: OpenAI API Platform
products.data_scope: API data NOT used for training by default (enterprise plan). Data residency available for eligible customers.
products.notes: Developer API with enterprise compliance, SOC 2 Type 2 coverage, ISO 27001 certification, and FedRAMP authorization

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered subscriptions. Consumer: Free tier, Plus ($20/mo), Pro ($200/mo). Teams/Orgs: Team ($30/person/mo), Business (custom), Enterprise (custom). API: Pay-as-you-go plus enterprise plans.
compare.data_residency: Yes, available in 10+ regions (EU, UK, US, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Australia, UAE) for Enterprise, Edu, and API customers

flags: Consumer plans (Free/Plus/Pro) train on user data by default with opt-out required. This is standard for free tiers but represents a privacy difference from paid business/enterprise products.
FedRAMP Moderate authorization is recent (March 2025) - may have limited government adoption yet as it's a new fast-track authorization pathway (FedRAMP 20x).
Identity verification: ChatGPT is unambiguously OpenAI's official product. All certificates and policies verified from openai.com domain. No conflation risk.
